summary: Comprehensive testing of FlipWill tarot app completed. All critical features verified working: Card Library with deck selector (Original 78 cards, Anime 49 cards), three-card reading flow with AI interpretation, and Clarifier feature (POST method fix verified). Both backend API tests (21/21 passed) and frontend UI tests successful.
passed_tests: Card Library deck selector shows Original (78 cards) and Anime (49 cards)
Deck switching works - card images change based on selected deck
Three-card reading flow: question -> draw -> reveal -> interpret -> reading result
Cards display correctly with images, lens keywords, and interpretations
Decision Insight section shows Pattern, Tension, Approach, Try This Now
Clarifier feature: button opens modal with 4 focus options
Clarifier card draw uses POST method (bug fix verified)
Clarifier card image displays correctly after draw
seed_data_creation: None required - app generates random cards
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical bugs fixed and verified: 1) DECK_CARDS config in server.py has 49 anime cards, 2) ClarifierPanel.js uses axios.post (not get) for /api/draw endpoint. Premium/payment system is MOCKED using localStorage.
